project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra writing assist feature poster
project_info.color_palette: Black, white, soft tablet UI pastels, pale blue highlights

main_subject.detail: Feature-demo poster showing the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra in landscape with split-screen productivity apps, an on-device writing-style popup, and a white S Pen laid diagonally across the display.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic premium product render, UI-feature launch poster, clean Samsung AI productivity aesthetic

composition_elements.text: Smarter writing, made simple / Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra / Galaxy AI
items: Top Left: Large centered white title 'Smarter writing, made simple'.
Top Right: Smaller centered lockup 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI' with sparkle icon.
Bottom Left: Small white legal/availability footnote block.
Bottom Right: Black negative space and glossy product reflection.

Center/Background: Landscape tablet showing split screen with 'Budgeting Breakdown' design work on the left and a 'Makers Market' webpage on the right, plus a floating 'Writing style' popup and a white S Pen laid diagonally across the upper-right portion of the screen.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp glass reflections, bright UI legibility, elegant contrast against deep black background

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra writing assist feature poster. Centerpiece is a landscape Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra on a black background, showing a split-screen workflow with 'Budgeting Breakdown' on the left, a 'Makers Market' webpage on the right, a floating 'Writing style' popup, and a white S Pen crossing the top-right of the screen. Background is minimal black with subtle reflection. Surrounding elements: exact title 'Smarter writing, made simple', lockup 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra' and 'Galaxy AI', and a small white legal footnote block at the bottom left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, studio lighting, crisp UI legibility and glass reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
